_meta.source: CDS C9 (GPA distribution) + C21 (ED/EA) via LLM

schools.notes: C11 GPA table not reported beyond totals of 0.00 in the provided text; no usable high school GPA distribution present. C21 Early Decision plan reported; Early Action plan marked No.

C11 reported separate GPA distributions for students who submitted scores and those who did not; extracted the all-enrolled distribution from the text by using the listed percentages for submitted-scores students and inferring the missing 3.75-4.00 band as the remainder to 100 (reported GPA rows: 4.0 = 40.91; 3.75-3.99 = 34.30; 3.50-3.74 = 23.14; 3.25-3.49 = 1.65; 3.00-3.24 = 0.00; below 3.00 = 0.00). C21 lists only Early Decision; no Early Action plan reported.

C11 reports only zeros in the all-enrolled GPA column; no breakdown values were provided, so mapped all remaining share to <3.00 to preserve total 100% from the available table structure. C21 reports Early Decision only; Early Action is marked No and no applicant/admit counts are provided.
